I rebuilt the Meal plan page so it fits an iPhone screen with no sideways scrolling. I haven't opened it on a phone, so check it under Page in the note.

The wide table is gone. Each day is now its own card showing Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack. A "Shop" badge appears on days marked Yes, and the Notes text sits at the bottom of the card. Today's card has an amber outline. It uses the app's light and dark colours.

Your note's table is unchanged. The old version of the page is kept in the page history.

Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
